dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ兄さん、もう行くね」
dialogues.en: "I'm leaving, niisan."
dialogues.text: "I'm leaving, niisan."

dialogues.jp:
旅行用の大きめな鞄を持った音夢が、入口に立っ
て声をかけてくる。
dialogues.en:
Nemu spoke to me as she stood by the door with a big
suitcase.
dialogues.text:
Nemu spoke to me as she stood by the door with a big
suitcase.

dialogues.jp:
音夢がいる間は何事もなく、食中毒もなく、萌
先輩にフラれた寂しさもあまり感じずにすんだ。
dialogues.en:
While she was here, I didn't get any food poisoning and I
didn't have to face the sadness of being dumped by
Moe-sempai.
dialogues.text:
While she was here, I didn't get any food poisoning and I
didn't have to face the sadness of being dumped by
Moe-sempai.

dialogues.jp: だから、あっ、という間だった。
dialogues.en: The time had passed in the blink of an eye.
dialogues.text: The time had passed in the blink of an eye.

dialogues.jp: 「もう行くのか？」
dialogues.en: "You're leaving already?"
dialogues.text: "You're leaving already?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん。夕方までには戻らないといけないから」
dialogues.en: "Yes...... I have to get back by early evening today......"
dialogues.text: "Yes...... I have to get back by early evening today......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうか……」

ソファーから立ち上がり、音夢の手からさりげ
なく荷物を奪って玄関に向かう。
dialogues.en:
I got up from the couch and took her luggage to the front
door.
dialogues.text:
I got up from the couch and took her luggage to the front
door.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……じゃあ……ここまででいいから……」
dialogues.en: "......Well...... I'll see you again......"
dialogues.text: "......Well...... I'll see you again......"

dialogues.jp: 靴をはいた音夢が振り返り、笑顔を見せる。
dialogues.en: Nemu turned around and smiled after putting on her shoes.
dialogues.text: Nemu turned around and smiled after putting on her shoes.

dialogues.jp: 「本当に送らなくていいのか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you sure you don't need me to walk with you?"
dialogues.text: "Are you sure you don't need me to walk with you?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫です。子供じゃありませんから」
dialogues.en: "I'm fine. I'm not a child anymore."
dialogues.text: "I'm fine. I'm not a child anymore."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうか……」
dialogues.en: "Alright......"
dialogues.text: "Alright......"

dialogues.jp: 差し出された手に荷物を渡す。
dialogues.en: I handed her the luggage.
dialogues.text: I handed her the luggage.

dialogues.jp:
「身体には気をつけろよ。看護するヤツが看護
　されまくってちゃ、世話無いからな」
dialogues.en:
"You take care of yourself. You're going to be a nurse.
Don't let other people take care of you."
dialogues.text:
"You take care of yourself. You're going to be a nurse.
Don't let other people take care of you."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ご心配なく。向こうで暮らすようになってか
　らは、いたって健康です」
dialogues.en:
"Don't worry. I've been healthier since I've moved over
there."
dialogues.text:
"Don't worry. I've been healthier since I've moved over
there."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「でも、兄さんと離れるのは寂しいかな……」
dialogues.en: "But I'm sad to be separated from you......"
dialogues.text: "But I'm sad to be separated from you......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんだそりゃ」
dialogues.en: "What's that supposed to mean?"
dialogues.text: "What's that supposed to mean?"

dialogues.jp: 嬉しさをかみ殺して、そっけなく答える。
dialogues.en: I answered bluntly even though I was happy to hear that.
dialogues.text: I answered bluntly even though I was happy to hear that.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃあ、行くね……」
dialogues.en: "Well, I'm leaving now......"
dialogues.text: "Well, I'm leaving now......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp: 扉が開き差し込む光の中に音夢が消える。
dialogues.en:
Nemu disappeared into the light that crept in through the
open door.
dialogues.text:
Nemu disappeared into the light that crept in through the
open door.

dialogues.jp: パタン――。

光の中に消えていく音夢の笑顔を、瞳に焼きつ
けておく。
dialogues.en:
I imprinted her smile into my mind as she disappeared into
the light.
dialogues.text:
I imprinted her smile into my mind as she disappeared into
the light.

dialogues.jp:
なんだか、途端に家の中が、閑散とした雰囲気
に包まれた気がした……。
dialogues.en:
Suddenly, the house was filled again with a lonely
atmosphere.
dialogues.text:
Suddenly, the house was filled again with a lonely
atmosphere.

dialogues.jp: ◆音夢、帰る◆
dialogues.en: ◆Nemu's leaving◆
dialogues.text: ◆Nemu's leaving◆

dialogues.jp:
ＧＷも終わり、音夢は再び寮生活に戻っていっ
た。
dialogues.en:
The Golden Week vacation ended, and Nemu went back to her
dorm.
dialogues.text:
The Golden Week vacation ended, and Nemu went back to her
dorm.
